qualifying_updates.factual_summary: The article frames AI agent cost monitoring as real-time tracking, attribution, thresholds, showback or chargeback, and cost-to-performance review for autonomous agents whose token, API, compute, and tool usage vary by behavior.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: During ingest, decide whether this becomes a local cost-governance note or only reinforces existing hybrid infrastructure economics guidance.
qualifying_updates.visible_date_basis: LinkedIn article line shows Published Jun 22, 2026.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: Hybrid local agent infrastructure should treat cost telemetry and ownership tags as operating requirements, not finance afterthoughts, because multi-agent workloads can silently expand spend through loops, tool calls, and infrastructure use.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: MindStudio defines agent ownership as ongoing accountability by a named person, organized around job definition, dependencies, boundaries, and review cadence; it warns that shared ownership creates monitoring and handoff gaps.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Ingest should keep MindStudio as a cited practice source while avoiding a local product encyclopedia entry.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: Local adoption guidance can sharpen operating agreements by requiring a named owner, documented boundaries, dependency diet, and review loop for every production or recurring agent.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: The article proposes an agent roster and ownership card containing agent name, named owner, job description, data sources, permissions, and known failure modes, then ties roster upkeep to deployment and review processes.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Consider adding an agent ownership card pattern to the local roster leaf during normal raw ingest.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: Agent ownership rosters should record the operational facts needed for audits, permission reviews, handoffs, and failure response rather than only listing agent names.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: The post presents remote engineering control-plane practices: choose host, workspace, branch, worktree, setup, attachments, skills, queue versus steer behavior, side chats, plans, goals, review diffs, inline comments, and narrow approval scopes.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Route broad Codex product details upstream; keep only the local operating-practice implications around scope, approvals, and review loops.
